scenes.name: THE HORIZON
lines: Classical arithmetic starts from a finished infinity: all the primes, lined up forever.
古典算术从一个已完成的无穷出发：全体素数，早已永远排好了队。
Here we keep only finite lists and loops that stop. Do primes, fractions and error budgets survive?
这里只保留有限的清单与会停下的循环。素数、分数与误差预算，还站得住吗？

scenes.name: DIVISION, THEN BACK
lines: Start with Euclid's division: a equals q times b, plus a smaller remainder.
从欧几里得带余除法开始：a 等于 q 乘 b，再加一个更小的余数。
Thirty thousand and thirty-one over thirteen: quotient two thousand three hundred and ten, remainder one.
Read backwards, that step is a certificate: the number minus the quotient times thirteen is one.
倒过来读，这一步就是一张证书：原数减去商乘 13，恰好等于 1。
Lean checks Bézout's identity for every pair: some integer mix of a and b equals their gcd.
Lean 内核检验了裴蜀恒等式：任意 a、b 都有整数 x、y 使 ax + by = gcd(a, b)。

scenes.name: EUCLID'S ESCAPE
lines: Euclid's recipe: multiply a finite list of primes, then add one.
欧几里得的配方：把一份有限素数清单乘起来，再加一。
For the first six lists, the witness happens to be prime.
前六份清单的见证数恰好都是素数。
Add thirteen: thirty thousand and thirty-one leaves remainder one for every listed prime.
加入 13：30031 被清单上每个素数去除，余数都是 1。
Yet the search stops at fifty-nine: fifty-nine times five hundred and nine, and fifty-nine was never listed.
可是搜索在 59 处停下：30031 = 59 × 509，而 59 从不在清单上。
Lean checks, for any list with positive product: product plus one has a prime factor off the list.
Lean 内核对任何乘积为正的清单检验了：乘积加一，必有一个不在清单上的素因子。

scenes.name: A FRACTION THAT STOPS
lines: Run the same division on a fraction: thirty-four over twenty-one becomes one; one, one, one, one, one, two.
Fibonacci ratios are the slow case: every quotient but the last is one.
斐波那契之比是最慢的情形：除最后一个外，每个商都是 1。
Euler and Wallis build the convergents: each new top is the quotient times the last, plus the one before.
欧拉—沃利斯递推给出渐近分数：新分子等于部分商乘上一个分子，再加前一个分子。
Lean bounds the length by twice the binary log of the denominator, plus one: here seven, at most nine.
Lean 内核给出长度上界：分母二进制对数的两倍再加一。这里是 7，上界 9。

scenes.name: UNIT AREA
lines: Each step is the matrix a, one, one, zero, of determinant minus one.
每一步都是矩阵 (a, 1; 1, 0)，行列式为 −1。
So neighbours cross-multiply to plus or minus one: thirty-four times eight, minus thirteen times twenty-one.
于是相邻渐近分数交叉相乘恰得 ±1：34 × 8 − 13 × 21 = −1。
Lean checks this sign rule for every list, so every convergent is already in lowest terms.
Lean 内核对任意系数表检验了这条符号律，因此每个渐近分数天生就是既约的。
Divided out, neighbours differ by one over their product, closing in from alternate sides.
两边除以分母：相邻渐近分数之差是分母乘积的倒数，从两侧交替逼近。

scenes.name: QUARTER DEPTH
lines: Last, the error budget: a quarter to the N shrinks to zero, so some depth works.
最后是误差预算：四分之一的 N 次方趋于零，所以总有某个深度够用。
In integers: majorant seven halves, tolerance one tenth, and seventy over two is thirty-five.
改用整数：主界 7/2，容差 1/10，70 除以 2 得 35。
Thirty-five lies between sixteen and sixty-four, so the quarter depth is two.
35 落在 16 与 64 之间，所以四分深度是 2。
Lean checks, with an empty axiom list on the strict backend: seventy is below one hundred twenty-eight.
Lean 内核检验了这条整数不等式，严格后端的公理清单为空：70 < 128。
A classical shadow carries it to the reals: seven over one hundred twenty-eight, under one tenth. Depth one fails.
经典阴影桥把它传到实数：7/128 小于 1/10。深度 1 则不够。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Math, chapter thirteen.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第十三章
